Behind the comparison.

The useful details, without the guesswork.

Specifications come first.

Each hardware record links to its original source. Charts use the same unit and start at zero. Missing information stays unavailable; it never becomes a zero.

Specs are not FPS.

Memory, clock speeds, bandwidth and core counts describe hardware. They do not establish how fast a game runs. This catalog does not include a matched game FPS dataset.

Benchmarks need context.

Where available, PassMark G3D values are an inherited snapshot dated September 12, 2026, linked to PassMark. They aggregate different systems and are not directly controlled game comparisons.

Compatibility has limits.

The PC builder checks indexed sockets, memory, storage ports, slots and power. Its power estimate combines CPU TDP, GPU board power and a 100 W allowance, then adds a 25% margin. Check exact dimensions, cooling, BIOS and connectors with the manufacturer.

Product photography.

Featured RTX 5070 and RTX 5060 Ti photos show ASUS Prime and ASUS Dual models. Comparison values describe reference GPU specifications; partner card designs and clock speeds may differ. Image sources are linked below each comparison.

Need the source?

Open “Sources & model notes” under any comparison.
